message: NO_TRADE: The complete 18-symbol 15:00 UTC package was valid, FRESH, and MARKET_OPEN. EURUSD, GBPUSD, GBPJPY, and AUDJPY held only marginal breakout closes, while EURCAD and GBPCAD remained extended with overbought momentum. XAUUSD reversed sharply and the earlier AUDUSD breakout failed to hold. No clean, non-chasing Friday setup qualified.
